title: Ethan's week home
intro: I'm in town for a stretch in September. Here's where I'll be. Add your name to anything you want to come to.

events.title: Florida Fin Fest
events.description: Outdoor ocean-conservation and music festival on the beach. Andy Frasco & The U.N., Magic City Hippies, Future Joy, Supertaste and more. General admission is free and it's all ages; VIP upgrades are sold separately. I'll be there from early afternoon into the evening.
events.image_alt: Florida Fin Fest 2026 lineup poster, illustrated with reef fish and a shark
events.image_credit: Florida Fin Fest official 2026 lineup poster (flfinfest.com)

events.title: Riverside Flow meetup
events.description: Flow arts meetup under the Fuller Warren Bridge. Bring a prop and play, learn something new, or just come sit by the river and watch. Free, no ticket.
events.image_alt: Map of Riverside Arts Market under the Fuller Warren Bridge on the St. Johns River

events.title: Bonnie x Clyde at Decca Live
events.description: Vocal-driven electronic DJ set at Decca. 18+, doors at 10 and it runs late. Ticketed - grab one before the night of.
events.image_alt: Bonnie x Clyde tour flyer for Saturday, September 19, 2026 at Decca Live, Jacksonville
events.image_credit: Bonnie x Clyde / Decca Live official event flyer (via Eventbrite)
